subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Their teacher, Ms. Gao, explained that the bird might be seeing its own reflection and thinking it was…”?
options: Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.
Students put drops of color on the paper and placed the paper outside for ten seconds.
During art class, the teacher showed students how to fold paper cranes.
The students made paper leaves and placed them on the window.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students put drops of color on the paper and placed the paper outside for ten seconds.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「During art class, the teacher showed students how to fold paper cranes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Their teacher, Ms. Gao, explained that the bird might be seeing its own reflection and thinking it was another bird. The students…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Their teacher, Ms. Gao, explained that the bird might be seeing its own reflection and thinking it was another bird. The students made paper…」，答案為「The students made paper leaves and placed them on the window.」。
